  <S>_x000D__x000A_  <div>My idea is to run all medical equipment and/or appliance repair through the service desk, for all of WHA. Users would log&#160;in and create a ticket, which would be followed up on by a technician from purchasing department. Repairs were handled locally in the past, but over time, there has been a gradual shift and most (if not all) medical equipment repairs are run through the PD. I have also been handling some general&#160;appliance repairs or replacements. This idea does not currently take in all preventative maintenance, but it most certainly could be used for that as well. I have talked about this idea in the past and have already done some of the initial work to get it started, but I feel that it needs to be evaluated for sustainability and for the impact it would have on the users. I need the support of the WHA community on this one - does it make sense? Will it be a positive change for everyone? (This idea also assumes that all sites have had an inventory, with a WHA asset tag assigned. This would mean that when the site is filling out the ticket, they only have to list out the issue and then provide the WHA asset number. I would have all the pertinent information on file, such as serial numbers, make and model, vendor, manufacturer, and could easily determine which is the best route for repair, based on that simple asset tag. Inventories have been completed at the following locations&#58; LD, HB, TN, OC, NB, NWG-PK and GW, MBC-GW will be done the week prior to opening at the new location.)</div>_x000D__x000A_</S>

<Objs Version="1.1.0.1" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/powershell/2004/04">
